# Function body fingerprinting ignoring comments and formatting

The body_hash function provides a stable way to fingerprint the logical content of a function or symbol, ignoring comments and code formatting. By walking the AST with tree-sitter and hashing only meaningful tokens and structure, it reliably detects any substantive code change, aiding in change detection and tooling for source version management.
